statement: DNA methylation at a few hundred CpG sites predicts chronological age across most human tissues and cell types, and deviations of predicted from chronological age are associated with mortality in cohort studies.

measurement.assay: DNA methylation array; elastic net predictor
measurement.effect: high correlation with chronological age; age acceleration associated with mortality

replication.note: Reproduced in many independent cohorts; the association is not in dispute.

drift: A validated predictor of age and an association with mortality are being used as an intervention endpoint. Predicting an outcome and responding usefully to treatment are different properties.
limitations: no evidence that intervention-induced clock change predicts outcome

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
